summary: Freeze the long-session requirements/design and bound the existing complete Session JSON cache by source bytes and entry count.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing SessionStore read cache; no new execution or authorization owner.
components.disposition: Retain at most 8 cached complete session objects and 64 MiB of serialized source weight, use LRU on hits, do not retain oversized or unstable snapshots, and preserve full read results and existing identity, retraction and save semantics. Source bytes are a proxy, not a process RSS limit. Subsequent read index and model working-set work are explicitly staged, not implemented by this patch.
evidence: 2026-11-24 read-only incident: one 249-message history limit=1 request took 33 ms; another 7,533-message session took 1.437 s. Complete JSON cache previously had only an entry-count bound.

Candidate targeted tests: 82 passed including source-weight eviction, LRU, oversized exact reads, external growth, replacement between stat and open, entry count, session leases, sync and history routes. Ruff passed.
components.verification_level: Targeted isolated candidate tests passed; independent exact-SHA review, complete R9, remote CI and deployment remain pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Reviewer may veto if the weight proxy is misrepresented as RSS, cache behavior loses exact history or causes unacceptable reparse cost, or any existing session identity, retraction or lease contract regresses.
components.rollback_route: Revert the isolated cache patch; no data migration or deletion. The original authoritative session JSON and events remain unchanged.
